summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes a heavily obfuscated bundled payload
details: @or-sdk/billing-internal@27.2.3 declares a preinstall lifecycle script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods the extracted binary to 0o755, and invokes it via execFileSync against the package-local math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line file marked '// @bun @bun-cjs' with string-array rotation (function WV8StW rotates array n7gIxM), hex-encoded numeric tokens, hex-mangled identifiers, and a decoder alphabet — obfuscation shape whose contents are unreadable by Node-based scanners. The obfuscated payload is executed automatically on `npm install` under an alternate runtime fetched at install time, so the code that runs on installer machines is not the JavaScript that appears in the package's declared source. The package advertises itself as a TypeScript billing SDK; downloading a second language runtime at preinstall to execute an unrelated bundled file is inconsistent with that purpose and matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern for supply-chain attacks.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
